Options:
  --inventory INVENTORY             Select an inventory path or host list
  -i INVENTORY                      Select an inventory path or host list
  --limit PATTERN                   Limit hosts
  -l PATTERN                        Limit hosts
  --extra-vars EXTRA_VARS           Set extra variables
  -e EXTRA_VARS                     Set extra variables
  --check                           Predict changes without applying tasks
  -C                                Enable check mode
  --diff                            Display file differences
  -D                                Display file differences
  --tags TAGS                       Select task tags
  --skip-tags TAGS                  Exclude task tags
  --list-hosts                      List targeted hosts
  --list-tasks                      List selected tasks
  --syntax-check                    Check playbook syntax
  --user REMOTE_USER                Select the remote login user
  --private-key FILE                Select an SSH private key
  --become                          Enable privilege escalation
  --become-user USER                Select the privilege escalation user
  --forks FORKS                     Set worker count
  --vault-password-file FILE        Select a vault password file
